name: scene-ferry
title: Ferry
description: Four stops across the Mandovi: a river ferry in ballpoint hatching, with a small jetty on the far side, two channel posts and a big jetty on the near bank, each with a lamp. The step attribute sails it to a stop; absent, it idles at the first and never moves on by itself. Quiet is a hairline still; playful advances a stop on a click and a kite circles.

budget.reason: a whole river view drawn by hand: far bank, jetties, posts, near bank, a canoe and the ferry, in ink and in hairline
